summary: Kanzhun Ltd filed a Form 6-K attaching a Hong Kong Next Day Disclosure Return detailing share repurchases for cancellation. Between March 20 and April 15, 2026, the issuer repurchased over 12.5 million Class A ordinary shares at prices from US$6.5654 to US$7.1427, representing up to ~0.08% of issued shares per day. These open-market buybacks are part of an ongoing capital return program, with no tender offer or shareholder vote. The disclosed repurchases have not yet been cancelled as of May 13, 2026. Investors should monitor the pace of buybacks for signals of management's view on intrinsic value.
